description: If \(f:A\to B\) is constant on classes, its induced quotient map is surjective onto \(B\) if and only if \(f\) is surjective.
signature:
Quotient.lift_surjective_iff.{u_3, u_4} {α : Sort u_3} {β : Sort u_4} {s : Setoid α} (f : α → β)
  (h : ∀ (a b : α), a ≈ b → f a = f b) : Function.Surjective (Quotient.lift f h) ↔ Function.Surjective f
